en-US.author: CAST AI Group, Inc.
en-US.description: A terminal coding agent powered by multi-model orchestration.
en-US.longDescription: Kimchi is a terminal coding agent that routes tasks to different large language models by role, such as orchestrator, builder, reviewer, and explorer, through its multi-model orchestration.
en-US.name: Kimchi
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
New Features
- feat(mcp): negotiate 2026-07-28 by default to support MRTR-only servers by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1670
- feat(acp): restore the SSO org-selection leg — sso_await settles the org list, sso_select_org completes the flow by @cast-vytautas in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1716
Bug Fixes
- fix(mcp): consume tools/list_changed without advertised capability by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1703
- fix(permissions): tell the model when plan mode hides MCP tools by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1705
- fix(mcp): keep explicit Connect sign-ins; add auth diagnostics to probes by @josemonteiro in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1704
- fix(auto-model): send auto-routed requests without provider-pinning headers by @iamhatesz in https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/pull/1719
Full Changelog: https://github.com/getkimchi/kimchi/compare/v1.33.2...v1.34.0

zh-CN.description: 由多模型编排驱动的终端编码代理。
zh-CN.longDescription: Kimchi 是一款终端编码代理，通过多模型编排按角色（编排者、构建者、审查者、探索者等）将任务路由到不同的大语言模型。
